wiki_text: On 2 June 2026 Energy World Corporation (ASX:EWC) agreed to sell the two Siemens SGT6-5000F gas turbines and one steam turbine long held idle at Pagbilao to US-listed Hallador Energy for US$350 million, booking a ~US$285 million non-cash impairment against the power-plant assets — 17 years after the project's 2009 launch, having never reached commercial operation. EWC's stated intent (per its ASX filings) is to keep developing the Pagbilao LNG import terminal itself as a standalone third-party-access facility, decoupled from the now-abandoned integrated power plant. IEEFA and local Quezon community/church groups (PMCJ, QUEEN) characterise the divestment as confirming the wider project is a stranded asset that never advanced past ~70% construction (as of 2024) with no PPA or gas supply secured. This is why GEM keeps the terminal at 'shelved' rather than escalating to 'cancelled'.
